program_summary.description: Builds an analysis-ready establishment file for a single reference period by merging the control file and prior-period employment onto collected microdata, keeping establishments above a minimum employment threshold, and computing a separations rate along with a period-over-period employment change. Also averages separations and openings by state into a review table.

macro_reference.name: est_snap
macro_reference.purpose: Joins the control file D2 and prior-period file D3 onto raw microdata D1, applies the employment-level retention threshold, derives the separations rate and employment change, and writes WORK.O1 plus the by-state summary for reference period `p`.

variable_dictionary.name: ESTID
variable_dictionary.label: Establishment identifier
variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through unchanged from the merged input datasets (join key).

variable_dictionary.name: ST
variable_dictionary.label: State FIPS code
variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through unchanged from the merged input datasets (join key).

variable_dictionary.name: PER
variable_dictionary.label: Reference period YYYYMM
variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through from the input file when populated; if blank, backfilled from the &p macro variable at call time.

variable_dictionary.name: EMPL
variable_dictionary.label: Total employment level
variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through unchanged from the raw microdata file D1.

variable_dictionary.name: SEP
variable_dictionary.label: Total separations
variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through unchanged from the raw microdata file D1.

variable_dictionary.name: JO
variable_dictionary.label: Job openings count
variable_dictionary.derivation: brought in from the control file D2 in the join.

variable_dictionary.name: HIR
variable_dictionary.label: Total hires
variable_dictionary.derivation: brought in from the control file D2 in the join.

variable_dictionary.name: P_EMPL
variable_dictionary.label: Prior-period employment level
variable_dictionary.derivation: prior-period value joined from the prior-period file D3 for period-over-period comparison.

variable_dictionary.name: SEPR
variable_dictionary.label: Total separations per 100 employees
variable_dictionary.derivation: computed as round(100*SEP/EMPL, 0.01) when EMPL > 0, else set to missing.

variable_dictionary.name: ST
variable_dictionary.label: State FIPS code
variable_dictionary.derivation: grouping variable carried through from the class statement (ST).

variable_dictionary.name: SEP
variable_dictionary.label: Total separations (mean across records)
variable_dictionary.derivation: computed via PROC SUMMARY as the mean of this variable across records sharing the same ST (name unchanged from the input -- the `mean=;` output statement was not given explicit new names).

variable_dictionary.name: JO
variable_dictionary.label: Job openings count (mean across records)
variable_dictionary.derivation: computed via PROC SUMMARY as the mean of this variable across records sharing the same ST (name unchanged from the input -- the `mean=;` output statement was not given explicit new names).
